text:
sophia: getting alerts from pager — ALB target group 'gpu-edge-pool' showing targets Unhealthy, deregistering after 3 failed checks :grimacing:
matt: timeline? any config changes this morning?
sophia: we flipped the annotation to enable proxy-protocol on the svc to preserve client IPs for telemetry around 10:58. Alerts started ~11:02.
kai: can reproduce locally — envoy sidecar is logging: "invalid proxy protocol header: unsupported version" when the ALB hits the nodePort health check. app logs show connection closed immediately.
ashley: ALB health checks include the PROXY header once proxy-protocol is enabled on the target group. Envoy needs to be explicitly configured to parse PROXY v1/v2. Did the sidecar listener expect plain HTTP?
sophia: yes listener was plain HTTP. We expected ALB to strip PROXY for health checks but it doesn't — it just sends PROXY before every TCP stream.
matt: quick check: `kubectl describe svc gpu-edge` shows `service.beta.kubernetes.io/aws-load-balancer-proxy-protocol: '*'` set.
kai: confirmed from packet capture on node: first bytes are `\x0d\n\r\n\x00\r\n\n` (PROXY v2 magic) then gibberish to envoy -> envoy rejects -> ALB marks target unhealthy.
ashley: two remedies: 1) turn off proxy protocol on the target group (loses client IP), 2) configure envoy listener to accept PROXY (v2) for health check path only, or 3) use separate health-check-only target group without proxy protocol.
sophia: what's the least risky immediate fix to restore targets?
matt: flip the annotation back to remove proxyprotocol on svc -> ALB will stop sending PROXY and targets should recover within one health-check cycle. low risk.
kai: long-term we should update envoy bootstrap to accept PROXY v2 on the health listener, or add a tiny sidecar that strips PROXY before envoy. Also consider separate target group for healthchecks in terraform.
sophia: rolling the annotation back now. will post when targets are healthy.
deploy-bot: deploy started by sophia at 2024-04-05T11:12:10Z: `kubectl annotate svc gpu-edge service.beta.kubernetes.io/aws-load-balancer-proxy-protocol-`
matt: seeing targets come back: ALB shows 12/12 healthy again. nice.
ashley: opened infra ticket INFRA-4720 to track adding PROXY v2 parsing to envoy bootstrap and updating terraform to create a healthcheck-only target group when service has proxy-protocol enabled.
sophia: thanks everyone. lesson: enabling proxy-protocol is cluster-impacting if sidecars aren't configured. :memo:
matt: add a runbook step: check sidecar envoy config before flipping proxy-protocol on svc.
kai: and add an automated smoke test that hits nodePort with PROXY header to fail fast in staging.
sophia: filing PR for the runbook now.
matt: :thumbsup:
